tail:
Batch 73 authoring and evidence are complete. The A/B pages are YAML-only, and the 13 draft items have current dependency records: **10 ready, 3 escalated**.

Scoped proof layout, strict contracts, coverage, source-fetch, rendering, and content-policy checks pass. The author-check reports `no-qed` on the three escalated items; their missing multi-cusp deformation and general rigidity arguments are documented in the items and cross-batch evidence. I left those proofs without completion markers.

The full-scope dependency checks still need owner reconciliation: four unrelated items have stale dependency levels, and the shared batch-level aggregate is stale. Batch 73 still recomputes to level 7 with prerequisites 57, 68, and 72; I left the shared file unchanged.

The final coverage includes 11 verified sources and 34 harvested results. I added the [Farb–Margalit treatment of torus curves and the bigon criterion](https://pagine.dm.unipi.it/~a019210/Farb%20Magalit_Primer%20on%20Teichmuller%20theory.pdf).
